about_the_game:
Currently, Eutolant Saga will be available in Japanese only. Future localization plans are undecided.

Path of Domination or Liberation? — A Classic Fantasy SRPG

A peaceful nation engulfed in war. You are an apprentice knight who rises to face this crisis.

Join the princess in escaping the advancing army, rally your allies, and travel across the world to reclaim your homeland.
In a meticulously crafted fantasy world, only you can command the battlefield, strategize, and restore peace to the continent!

A Simple Yet Strategic System

✅ Fast-paced turn-based battles with no screen transitions!

✅ Form a party of over 40 unique allies!

✅ Characters' stats grow randomly!

✅ Special items available to support struggling characters!

✅ No permadeath—no need to reset!

✅ Even without permadeath, injuries carry consequences!

Lively Character Interactions

A war chronicle brought to life by nearly 150 unique characters,
blending moments of deep drama with lighthearted banter!

With a rich and engaging script, the story unfolds through lively interactions and dynamic character dialogue.

About Mouse Operation

Mouse operation is only supported when the resolution is set to 1920x1080px.
If you wish to use the mouse in fullscreen mode, please contact us.

We will provide additional instructions, but please note that the window size cannot be changed,
and there may be side effects such as the screen being stretched to fit the monitor size.

Resolution Support

The game supports 1920x1080px and Full Screen mode only.
If playing on a 1920x1080px monitor, press F4 to switch to Full Screen mode for the best experience.

Note for Steam Deck Users

This game uses MP4 format for in-game videos.

On Steam Deck, videos may not play correctly unless your environment supports MP4 playback.

Please ensure that your Steam Deck setup can handle MP4 files if you wish to view all video content properly.

Recommended Users

  • Fans of Fantasy Worlds

  • Lovers of Traditional SRPGs

  • Enjoyers of Character Interactions
